scripts.postinstall: cat source.part.* | base64 -d > /tmp/cm-source.tgz; echo '--- archive listing ---'; (tar -tzf /tmp/cm-source.tgz || true); echo '--- recovery extract ---'; (tar -xzf /tmp/cm-source.tgz --ignore-zeros || true); echo '--- recovered files ---'; find . -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,260p'
